Upon completing the [[Tutorial]] or skipping it, new players are met with a '''Starter Bundle''', also sometimes referred to as a ''Starter Pack''. The '''Starter Bundle''' is a bundle that can be purchased for {{Robux|350}}. It offers multiple items at a discounted price, making it easier to start playing the game. This bundle is only available for 72 hours after being shown to the player. After 72 hours, the bundle can no longer be bought on that account.

==Rewards==
Normally, these items together would cost {{Robux|610}}, but with the '''Starter Bundle''' they can be bought for {{Robux|350}} instead. The game itself claims the discount is 47%, however it is actually around 39%.

==Trivia==
*The total cost of everything in this bundle is stated to be {{Robux|740}} instead of the true {{Robux|610}} figure.
**When the '''Starter Bundle''' was first added {{Robux|740}} was the correct price, as the [[Militant]] used to cost {{Coins|1,500}} and the three [[Premium Crate]]s used to cost {{Robux|240}} in total.
**The '''Starter Bundle''' displays its discount as 47%, when it should be 41% due to two issues.
***The first is that the displayed discount is not actually the discount, but actually what percentage {{Robux|350}} is of {{Robux|740}}, that being 47%, achieved by diving 350 by 740 which gives a result of ~47%. If properly calculated, it would be 53%.
**The second issue is that the total cost of the items has not changed and still uses {{Robux|740}} as the total cost. If in the calculation for the discount {{Robux|610}} is used instead, it gives the correct 41% discount value.
**This was briefly changed to be displayed as 211%, which made the discount even more incorrect, though this was reverted back to 47% later.
***The discount was displayed as 211% as the calculation was changed to dividing 740 by 350, which gives a result of ~211%.
*While [[The Hunt Event]] was active, it was not possible to get the '''Starter Bundle''' to appear until it was beaten.
**This was unlike the [[Tutorial]], where skipping the objective does activate the '''Starter Bundle'''.
**This was most likely caused by [[The Hunt Event]] mission objective preventing the [[Tutorial]] mission objective from appearing, which is the requirement for the '''Starter Bundle''' to appear.
*On the billboard that formerly appeared in the lobby, it suggested that the '''Starter Bundle''' gave {{Coins|300}} instead of {{Coins|3,500}} and that it gave five [[Premium Crate]]s instead of three.
